markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (74%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Invasive probability is ~0%, but Normal and Benign are not separable at the 90% level. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 74%, Benign 26% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.89 / 64th percentile | Input acceptable despite blur |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent check agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Strong retrieval support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Scarce here; concept model leans non-invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 1, 6) · ↓ invasive · Scored present, but spot check failed 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) distorts features; Normal and Benign remain unresolved.
- Small test set (132 images); reliability error AUROC only 0.69.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 6, 9**: confirm glandular architecture is benign, not neoplastic.
2. **Region 8**: look for atypical cells confined within ducts (concept spot check 12/20).
3. **Regions 1, 6**: verify two-layered epithelium directly; concept check failed.
